source_caption_text:
When Lil Uzi Vert found the guy behind his music leaks 😭💀

In 2016, Lil Uzi Vert tracked down the man who had been leaking his unreleased music and confronted him in person. Uzi filmed the encounter in Philadelphia, leading to the now-famous clip where he repeatedly told the guy to “stand up” and “sit down.”

The man claimed he had hacked Uzi because the rapper wasn’t responding to his messages, but Uzi discovered he had much more than just a few songs. His phone reportedly contained a large collection of unreleased music, contact information and verses from Uzi and other artists.

The whole moment quickly became a viral hip-hop clip, but behind the memes was a serious issue for Uzi. Having unreleased music leaked can mess with an artist’s plans and take away control over when and how their music gets released.
